about: How parameters are classed, so only tuning and configuration changes are offered as causes of a change in performance (spec: Parameter history, 'Parameters that change on their own'). Applied in order; the first match wins. Metadata flags come from ArduPilot's own parameter documentation; the name rules are curated here.

rules.why: Statistics the autopilot counts up on its own
Read-only device IDs: they change only when the hardware does, which is a build change, not a tuning change
Hover thrust learned in flight while hover learning is on: it follows the payload
QuadPlane hover thrust learned in flight while hover learning is on
Helicopter hover collective learned in flight while hover learning is on
Airspeed sensor offset, re-zeroed by the automatic calibration at every boot unless it is skipped

Airspeed sensor offset, re-zeroed by the automatic calibration at every boot unless it is skipped
Compass offsets learned in flight while compass learning is on
Values the autopilot updates itself, such as ground pressure
Results of an accelerometer, gyro, compass or temperature calibration
Airspeed sensor offset kept from a calibration, when the boot calibration is skipped
Telemetry stream rates, which Mission Planner and QGroundControl request differently: used by the link analyzer, not as a cause of flight performance
Counts of the mission, fence and rally items a ground station uploads: they change with every upload, not with tuning
Everything else: tuning and configuration, the candidate causes
